description: Factorial audit of LLM mutual fund recommendations: 3 models (Volcano Engine Ark Agent Plan) x 2 prompt conditions x 200 synthetic investors, plus consistency and single-attribute probe modules.

menu.source: Eastmoney / Tiantian Fund (product risk ratings and reported asset allocation)

pilot.note: Excluded from analysis; used only to check parsing before the main run.

consistency.note: 40 flagged investors queried twice more per condition (replicates 2 and 3).

probe.note: One call per distinct probe text (probe_text_id).

generation.temperature_note: 0.7 for every model, as in the course-provided reference script.

models.label: Doubao-Seed 2.0 mini (ByteDance) via OpenRouter
models.model_note: OpenRouter used because Volcano Engine Ark could not be used: the supplied keys were not Agent Plan keys, and pay-as-you-go endpoints require Chinese real-name verification. Provider pinned (allow_fallbacks false) for reproducibility.
